## Purpose

Compare agent filesystem FUSE behavior on the same command workloads: LayerFS A2, Cloudflare computerd, Drive9 and JuiceFS. Requested by the owner on 2026-10-04. This issue records existing A2/computerd evidence and tracks new Drive9/JuiceFS runs. Related investigation: #305.

## Scope and completion criteria

- [x] Record existing A2 and computerd E01–E19 real-project results, including failed, exceeded and unrun cells.
- [x] Record existing A2 and computerd C01–C12 offline fs-bench results.
- [x] Record Drive9 E01–E19 selections, retaining actual attempts, prerequisite failures and any budget-blocked NOT_RUN cells with exact identities.
- [x] Collect all Drive9 C01–C12 selections, retaining failed, exceeded and incomplete operations.
- [x] Record JuiceFS E01–E19 dispositions: 4 completed, 4 EXCEEDED, 12 budget-blocked NOT_RUN; failed initial replay wiring attempts retained.
- [x] Run the same C01–C12 command bodies on JuiceFS (all 12 completed).
- [x] Publish the four-system matrix with backend/cache/architecture/verification qualifications and raw receipt custody.

## Method and limits

One attempt per selected cell, no warm-up, no averaging/best-of/replacement runs. Pristine setup is prepared once and independently copied for every mutation-capable run; no previous result is reused as a sample. Fresh mount, declared cache preconditioning, exact commands and original workload sizes. Default complete command budget is 15 s; do not enlarge timeouts or shrink a workload to make it pass. Failed/partial/unrun cells stay visible.

All results are exploratory diagnostics, admission_eligible=false. Cache invalidation has no residency proof. Absolute durations from different architectures/backends are side-by-side observations, not a matched product ranking. Mount/Exec/Unmount, setup, verification and complete command wall remain separate.

**A2** is permission-enforcing ext4 passthrough, native ARM64, with no store work. **Computerd** uses its official Linux x86-64 executable under emulation on the same ARM64 Docker VM. Its real-tree run uses file-backed SQLite WAL/normal for reusable fixtures; its fs-bench run uses default in-memory SQLite. Computerd cannot preserve original input timestamps across daemon restart; canonical bytes/path/kind/mode match, timestamp fidelity remains FAIL. Historical A2 timers have a documented polling-resolution erratum, material on sub-second cells; receipts were not rewritten.

Drive9 and JuiceFS selections are recorded below. Numeric observations are INELIGIBLE. Original workloads and third-party sources are unchanged; all input comes from the closed prepared Docker master.

## E01–E19 full-project workloads

F: 130,045 entries, 3,475,776,149 regular-file bytes. S removes node_modules: 35,024 entries. E12/E13 replay the exact 95,021-entry / 2,126,509,110-byte dependency tree with one construction worker. E01 is selected on F and S; the remaining cases use F except E12/E13 on S.

Exec seconds below exclude mount/unmount/setup/verification. EXCEEDED means the measured lifecycle did not finish; 15 s is a cap, not a completed Exec value.

E16 completed all 10,000 writes / 1,000,000 bytes. Prefix counters emit every 100 operations; do not extrapolate completion time from them.

Full result-tree verification was skipped in that computerd run.

Reports/unchanged compact receipts are currently in the local experiment worktree under core/docs/issues/305/; these local producing commits are **unpublished**, so no public commit link is claimed. This issue includes the result tables directly. Raw evidence is append-only under benchmark-results/experiment/real-tree/. Existing source and runtime identities have been rechecked before creating this issue.

Reference: [Cloudflare published performance table](https://github.com/cloudflare/computer/blob/main/docs/19_performance.md). Its different hardware/warm-up method is not a matching control; some printed ratios disagree with the displayed duration operands, so any arithmetic must use raw durations.


## JuiceFS campaign qualifications (2026-10-04)


Official JuiceFS 1.4.1 Linux ARM64 runs natively in the shared Docker VM.
Backend: standalone SQLite metadata + local file object storage on ext4,
foreground FUSE, `--hide-internal --cache-size=0 --max-uploads=1`, no writeback,
otherwise release defaults. Release archive, binary and runtime image identities
are in [candidate identity comment](https://github.com/Ephemeral-AI-Lab/layerfs/issues/306#issuecomment-5976171432). No third-party changes.
Original command bodies, environment and replay sizes remain unchanged.

F and S were imported once and closed after canonical qualification. All
130,045 F entries (3,475,776,149 bytes) and 35,024 S entries match their original
path/kind/mode/content identities; **zero mtime mismatches** on either base.
F acquisition/qualification wall 323.193258 s, separately from every workload.
Each sample uses `cp --reflink=never -a` of the entire independent closed backing,
including upstream-retained SQLite WAL/SHM and objects. Root mode0700 prepared
input is never changed. Fixed 15 s complete command budget, no exception.

Every numeric result is **INELIGIBLE**, admission_eligible=false: sync +
VM drop_caches=3 before fresh timed mount has no whole-input residency proof.
Inclusive create/read/copy bodies may read their own writes, as in upstream.
Completed durations are observations of these command routes, not cold-storage
bandwidth or a matched product ranking. Full post-command result proof SKIPPED;
deterministic E exit/stdout checked. C commands all exit0. All mounts absent.


JuiceFS disposition: 16 completed INELIGIBLE cells, 4 EXCEEDED, 12 NOT_RUN. Full F backing copy cost 11.83–12.65 s; even E01 complete command was 16.970895 s against 15 s. F E01/E02/E04 completed (matching deterministic stdout); E03/E05 exceeded, and all five attempted F command budgets FAIL. Remaining twelve F cells NOT_RUN under the existing complete-command budget. All twelve C cells completed, exited0, cleaned mounts and fit the command budget (0.799–2.562 s). E01/S complete command 5.171 s fits. Corrected E12/E13 replay-v2 exceeded, with 16,200 entries / 32,236,539 bytes and 14,300 / 27,301,367 bytes acknowledged respectively. Initial v1 permission-denied wiring attempts remain retained separately. Their source-visible input permissions were not changed; the original A2 readable replay projection was restored before one corrected invocation per affected cell. No successful arm repeated.

C10 pure copy 11.008 ms is the unchanged `cp` command, which permits filesystem copy acceleration; do not report it as byte-copy bandwidth. JuiceFS 1.4.1 exposes CopyFileRange through its metadata engine ([official source](https://github.com/juicedata/juicefs/blob/v1.4.1/pkg/vfs/vfs.go#L866)), but this sample has no syscall trace proving that route. Full result-tree verification SKIPPED; no durability/memory admission claim. Producing harness commits `d041ab678` / `61df56bcd` and local `core/docs/issues/306/JUICEFS-REPORT.md` / `JUICEFS-RECEIPTS.json` remain unpublished.


## Drive9 measurements and retained failures

Drive9 has 32 terminal selection dispositions: 4 completed numeric INELIGIBLE, 4 EXCEEDED, 3 FAILED lifecycle/workload outcomes, 2 INCOMPLETE shell loops, and 19 final commands NOT_RUN (16 full-F budget omissions and 3 C prerequisites). E selections are 2 completed, 2 EXCEEDED and 16 NOT_RUN. All measured mounts were absent after cleanup; all provider stops exited0.

one upload producer and fresh client cache directories. All input and command
sizes are the original registered selections. Each sample independently copies
all closed TiDB/MinIO backing bytes; no shared mutable base or COW substitution.
Provider startup/cleanup and byte copy remain in complete-command wall.

All numeric observations INELIGIBLE: no whole-input residency proof; provider
heap after readiness is unknown. Mount/Exec/drain+Unmount use monotonic nanoseconds.
Complete command budget 15 s, inner lifecycle stop 15 s, no enlarged timeout.
Full post-command result verification SKIPPED, exact deterministic E exit/stdout
checked; the selected E09 route permits skipping nondeterministic TAP equality (its final call was NOT_RUN). A completed shell loop with
filesystem errors is INCOMPLETE and is not a valid speed for the requested
scenario. Short failed writes/opens are not 64 MiB transfer performance.

All raw receipts and identities are preserved in DRIVE9-RECEIPTS.json; each

Input acquisition/qualification is separate from every workload timer. Initial

First actual E01/F: Mount 0.247958209s, Exec 0.009270334s, drain/unmount 0.142633000s. Complete command 15.557863708s exceeds 15 s. Independent backing copy 10.356914125s; provider startup 1.764674791s. Complete command minus Exec = 15548593374/1e9 = 15.548593374s > 15 s. The remaining 16 F selections are NOT_RUN under that observed fixed-cost constraint; no larger budget or repeated E01 was used. This is an orchestration-budget limit, not proof that those 16 command bodies fail.

## Input qualification and retained prerequisite failures

- prepare/F/v1: FAILED; preparation wall 2672.554550595 s; canonical equal not qualified; continued entries not applicable; mtime differences not qualified. Evidence: `benchmark-results/experiment/real-tree/issue306-drive9-prepare-F-v1`.
- qualify/F/v2: PREPARED; preparation wall 3973.693120561 s; canonical equal True; continued entries 11609; mtime differences 0. Evidence: `benchmark-results/experiment/real-tree/issue306-drive9-qualify-F-v2`.
- prepare/S/v1: FAILED; preparation wall 1149.144470065 s; canonical equal not qualified; continued entries not applicable; mtime differences not qualified. Evidence: `benchmark-results/experiment/real-tree/issue306-drive9-prepare-S-v1`.
- qualify/S/v2: PREPARED; preparation wall 760.203997721 s; canonical equal True; continued entries 0; mtime differences 0. Evidence: `benchmark-results/experiment/real-tree/issue306-drive9-qualify-S-v2`.

Original F/S acquisition and verification used a shared 512 MiB container and
emitted OOM events. No E performance call had run. Their original E-v1 NOT_RUN
receipts are retained separately, without promotion or relabeling. Qualification
v2 continues an independent byte copy of retained stopped backing: only missing
or wrong-sized entries are copied; exact original modes/ownership/timestamps are
restored and the whole canonical manifest checked. Preparation uses Docker VM
default memory; every measured client remains512MiB/one CPU. Provider limits remain
TiDB 1536 MiB, MinIO 384 MiB and server 768 MiB, one CPU each. The workload, upload worker,
cache policy and 15 s measured budgets remain fixed. Preparation wall does not enter
Exec. An acquisition observation is not a phase-memory or workload-speed claim.

## Acknowledged partial work and cleanup

- E12/S: `{"bytes_written": 1241275, "entries_completed": 1400}`. These prefix counters do not establish completion.
- E13/S: `{"bytes_written": 1241275, "entries_completed": 1400}`. These prefix counters do not establish completion.

Per-cell cleanup, provider exit codes, artifact identities and budget arithmetic are in the compact evidence. A NOT_RUN cell has no invented cleanup or timing. Source commits differ between C and E because the preparation-domain correction occurred before the first actual E call. No third-party source was changed.

All 32 selections per new candidate have terminal dispositions; NOT_RUN denotes an unexecuted final command and is not a completion time. Raw evidence is append-only locally. This exploratory campaign makes no release-admission, durability, phase-memory or matched-ranking claim.

The existing A2/computerd matrices are recorded in this issue. Candidate preparation is underway; no Drive9/JuiceFS performance result is claimed yet.

* Drive9 source `0f0f301c8f720893248003f26c28d48d8432130d` built offline with Go 1.25.14 for Linux ARM64, using upstream release tags and readonly manifests. CLI SHA256 `54c2a3770a5bca8411d4508b3468418847a886511ef1876009295cb0d1699c40`; server SHA256 `6428aec27f3668abbcd4065c49028f0f581f2d75529533281db84d6920093961`. Isolated TiDB 8.5.6 unistore + real MinIO S3 provider and server are healthy. Full-remote `--profile=none` is planned so .git/node_modules are not routed to a local overlay.
* JuiceFS official 1.4.1 (`1.4.1+2026-07-30.0b90c7d`) Linux ARM64 archive verified against its published checksum, SHA256 `1015ade83a7a93180a29f6c93ee5780a3eda52522331934ef2ef0cc0921995fd`; binary SHA256 `1422869d1385c7c18b55c9a6b5a1c250e8c71f48c8dd5971425bf6fe2055890c`. Standalone SQLite metadata + local file object storage, persistent chunk cache disabled, one upload worker, no writeback. The 1,125-entry smoke fixture matches canonical path/kind/mode/bytes; a smoke append completed all 10,000 writes/1,000,000 bytes and cleaned its mount/backing. Smoke durations are not benchmark values.
* Supported JuiceFS `--hide-internal` hides live .accesslog/.stats/config/trash entries from directory listings, keeping the project namespace intact. Quiescent SQLite WAL/SHM files survive upstream clean exit and are copied together with the database and complete object directory; no third-party patch. Initial harness/setup failures are retained, including the blocked live-accesslog read. Full F fixture import is currently running once, then will be qualified/closed and reused.

Local frozen JuiceFS harness/plan source: `d041ab678` (unpublished). All candidate durations will remain exploratory INELIGIBLE without whole-input residency proof. One sample per cell and unchanged command bodies; failures/timeouts/unrun cells will be reported. Task remains open.

Drive9 C01–C12 selections are collected at frozen source `bb05bf203` (unpublished), native ARM64, full-remote profile none, TiDB unistore + real MinIO. No successful case was repeated. All numeric observations remain INELIGIBLE; no full result-tree proof.

C01 and C05 reported EAGAIN/missing-path errors inside the unchanged non-errexit shell loops. Their exit0 timings do not prove 1000-file/tree workload completion. C04 and C12 have no workload stderr errors, but full tree verification is SKIPPED. C02/C03 exceeded. C06/C07 failed to open big (EAGAIN), so their short failed-command durations are **not** 64MiB write/copy performance. C08 command exited0 but its public drain failed; C09/C10/C11 final commands were never started after failed preconditioning/drain. Every mount was absent and all provider stops exited0. No passing operation claim is made for any failed/incomplete cell.

C01 Exec1.291518s vs drain/unmount5.859227s demonstrates why Exec alone omits deferred upload work. Both are recorded, with the full10.592221s command. Lifecycle deadlines were not enlarged.

Full project F acquisition is currently running once, using the unchanged prepared original input. E selections and final four-system report remain pending. Failed setup attempts (missing uid account, Docker-injected proxy override, cp-a private mode mismatch) are retained separately. Corrected routing and ordinary exact-source chmod normalization allowed the 1125-entry smoke to qualify; its10000append writes passed without any published smoke timing.

Drive9 full original F acquisition failed after44.54min (separate preparation wall, no workload speed). Docker retained daemon events record an **OOM event in the512MiB client container** at termination. The FUSE connection ended; cp reported Transport endpoint is not connected and import_exit_code=1. Container wrapper exit0 means it successfully recorded that failure, not that import passed.

The original full F fixture did not qualify or close. All17F selections (E01/F and E02–E19 excluding E12/E13) are now **NOT_RUN**, with the failed acquisition cited. No measurement was performed on the partial tree, no workload shrunk, no frozen memory limit raised, and no successful selection repeated. Partial TiDB/MinIO backing and raw failure logs are retained in owned custody; all three provider stops exited0. This is preparation failure under this pinned local topology/limit, not a completed E workload timing or a universal Drive9 scalability claim.

The collector is now acquiring originalS (35,024entries, excludesnode_modules) once from the closed empty provider master for E01/S/E12/S/E13/S. Those selections remain pending. AllpreviousA2/computerd/JuiceFS andDrive9C rows stay unchanged. Fullfinalreport remains pendingS.

The original S input is now qualified through the corrected preparation-only resource domain: all35024entries match exact canonicalSHA375873367cf3f26b3d52caa1f26ce81d23bb4c92b1a6ad9137393e532a28af65, zero timestamp mismatches.
